explanation: Marx and Engels published the Manifesto in London in February 1848, just as revolutions broke out across Europe. Darwin's book appeared in November 1859, and its first printing sold out at once.

claims.text: The Communist Manifesto was first published in London in February 1848.
On the Origin of Species was first published in November 1859.
Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels wrote the Communist Manifesto.
The Communist Manifesto appeared as revolutions broke out across Europe in 1848.
The first printing of On the Origin of Species sold out on publication.
